Bloomington Common Council-Regular Session Memorandum
Council Chambers, City Hall, 401 North Morton Street, Bloomington, Indiana
Wednesday, July 29, 2026, at 6:30pm
Council President Asare called the meeting to order. [6:30pm]
1. Roll Call (*indicates participation via Zoom) [6:30pm]
Council Members:

2. Agenda Summation [6:31pm]
Council President Asare summarized the agenda.
3. Minutes for Approval [6:32pm]
Daily moved and Zulich seconded to approve the amended minutes of January 7, 2026,
January 14, 2026, February 4, 2026, February 25, 2026, and March 31, 2026. The motion
received a roll call vote of Ayes: 7, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
4. Reports [6:32pm]
4.1. Councilmembers
4.2. The Mayor, City Clerk, City Offices, and City Boards and Commissions [6:37pm]
There were no reports.
4.3. Council Committees
Piedmont-Smith presented an informal report on the Committee on Council Processes.
4.4. Public
5. Appointments to Boards and Commissions [6:45pm]
There were no appointments to boards or commissions.
6. Legislation for First Readings [6:45pm]
6.1. Ordinance 2026-16
To Amend an Ordinance Fixing the Salaries of Officers and Employees of the Police and Fire
Departments for the City of Bloomington, Indiana for the Year 2026 Council Sponsor - N/A
Daily moved and Zulich seconded that Ordinance 2026-16 be introduced and read by title and
synopsis only. The motion received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0. Crossley
read the legislation by title and synopsis.
Daily moved and Zulich seconded to discuss Ordinance 2026-16. The motion to discuss
Ordinance 2026-16 received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Daily moved and Zulich seconded to present Ordinance 2026-16 for second reading at the
next Regular Session to be held on August 5, 2026 at 6:30pm. The motion received a roll call
vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
6.2. Ordinance 2026-17
To Amend the 2026 Salary Ordinance of Appointed Officers, Non-Union, and A.F.S.C.M.E.
Employees for All Departments of the City of Bloomington, Indiana Council Sponsor - N/A
Daily moved and Zulich seconded that Ordinance 2026-17 be introduced and read by title and
synopsis only. The motion received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0. Crossley
read the legislation by title and synopsis.
Daily moved and Zulich seconded to discuss Ordinance 2026-17. The motion to discuss
Ordinance 2026-17 received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Daily moved and Zulich seconded to present Ordinance 2026-17 for second reading at the
next Regular Session to be held on August 5, 2026 at 6:30pm. The motion received a roll call
vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
7. Legislation for Second Readings and Resolutions [7:45pm]
7.1. Resolution 2026-15
Amending Title 2 of the Bloomington Municipal Code Regarding Establishment of the Fire
Merit Commission Council Sponsor - CM Zulich
Daily moved and Zulich seconded that Resolution 2026-15 be introduced and read by title
and synopsis only. The motion received a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
Crossley read the legislation by title and synopsis.
Daily moved and Zulich seconded that Resolution 2026-15 be adopted. The motion received
a roll call vote of Ayes: 8, Nays: 0, Abstain: 0.
8. Additional Public Comment [7:50pm]
9. Council Schedule [7:51pm]
10. Adjournment [7:51pm]
Asare adjourned the meeting.
Memorandum prepared by:
Deputy Clerk Jennifer Crossley
